name: Dreamina
summary: CapCut's AI studio for generating videos, images and short dramas from text or images.
description: Dreamina is CapCut's generative studio. It creates images with models such as Seedream and videos from text or images, and includes tools for restyling, remixing, avatars and short-form drama. It is aimed at ads, social content and product visuals. Free access is available to start; the site was advertising an introductory paid offer during this check, and regular subscription prices were not recorded.

howToUse.title: Open Dreamina
howToUse.description: Go to Dreamina and choose Create now or Sign in to enter the generative studio.

howToUse.title: Generate images and videos
howToUse.description: Create images with models such as Seedream, or make videos from text or from images.

howToUse.title: Restyle, remix, and build avatars
howToUse.description: Use restyling and remixing, then build avatars or a short-form drama aimed at ads, social content, or product visuals.
